# glassform

> Liquid glass for the web in every browser: WebGPU and WebGL2 renderers, a CSS tier for ordinary pages, React, Three.js and React Three Fiber bindings, and a SwiftUI-inspired layout engine. MIT licensed.

## Docs
- [Docs](https://gitguy268.github.io/glassform/#/docs): packages, backends per browser, React, plain JS, Three.js, R3F and CSS usage, limits
- [Fidelity](https://gitguy268.github.io/glassform/#/fidelity): how glassform is measured against native SwiftUI glass
- [Source](https://github.com/Gitguy268/glassform)

## Packages
- @glassform/react: LiquidCanvas, GlassContainer (material prop), Glass, Html (source, fit, fallback), GlassSurface
- @glassform/css: glass(element, options), <glass-surface>
- @glassform/core: Renderer (backend 'auto' | 'webgpu' | 'webgl2'), Scene, Container, Glass, Html, resolveMaterial
- @glassform/three: ThreeGlassRenderer
- @glassform/r3f: LiquidGlassR3F.Root / Render / Scene
- @glassform/layout: layout engine
